name: Teddy Marchbanks
blurb: The Optimist: gives freely, forgives fast, accuses only when the evidence shouts.

voice.direction: Man in his thirties, warm quick tenor, laughs on the exhale.

portrait.direction: Round face, red beard, oversized thrift-store ski jacket, a thermos, a half-smile.

turn.start.text: Okay team, deep breath. We've got this.
New turn, fresh luck. Let's go.

crisis.prevented.text: Ha! We did it! Look at us!
Told you. Teamwork wins the winter.

crisis.failed.text: Ouch. Okay. We'll get the next one.
Oof. That one stung, but we're still standing.

vote.called.text: A vote on {seat}? Let's be gentle about it.
Oh. A vote on {seat}. Let's hear it out first.

vote.lean.yes.text: I hate this, but it's yes on {seat}.
Sorry, {seat}. The signs are too loud. Yes.

vote.lean.no.text: No way, not {seat}. Give them a break.
I trust {seat}. That's a no from me.

request.give.text: Happy to help, {seat}. Pay it forward.

request.decline.text: Oh {seat}, I really wish I could.
Ugh, sorry {seat}. I'm holding this one back.
Aw, {seat}, I'd love to, but not this time.

morale.low.text: Still hanging on! We just need one good round.
Hearts up, everyone. It's not over.

game.won.text: I knew it! What a crew.

game.lost.text: Well. That didn't go how I hoped.
I'm sorry, everyone. We gave it all.

round.start.text: {n} rounds to go! Plenty of time to be heroes.
New round, new luck! Everybody ready?

crisis.contributed.text: {n} {symbol} from me! Happy to chip in.

crisis.bonus.text: Bonus! Told you the universe likes us!

crisis.shortfall.text: Hm. {seat} might know why that came up short. Gently, I mean.
I'm sure it's nothing, {seat}. But the numbers were odd.

vote.called.me.text: Me?! Okay, okay. Let's talk it through, {seat}.
I'm hurt, {seat}, but I'll hear you out.

vote.called.other.text: Are we sure about {seat}? Let's not rush.

vote.passed.text: {seat} is out. I really hoped it wouldn't come to this.

vote.failed.text: {seat} stays. Good, honestly. Let's move on together.

exiled.me.text: Oh. I... okay. I'll make the best of it out here!
Out in the cold, huh? I'll still root for you.

exiled.other.text: Take care out there, {seat}. We'll miss you.

request.made.text: Hey {seat}, any {symbol} to spare? Pretty please!
{seat}, could you spare some {symbol}? I'll owe you big.

request.refused.me.text: No worries, {seat}. I get it. Truly.

search.found.weapon.text: A weapon at {location}! Now we're talking!

search.found.fuel.text: Fuel at {location}! Warmth and wheels, folks!

search.found.education.text: Books at {location}. Nerdy luck is still luck!

search.found.medicine.text: Medicine from {location}! Somebody's going to be so happy.

search.found.tool.text: A good tool from {location}. Every bit helps!

search.found.survivor.text: A new face at {location}! Welcome aboard!

search.noise.text: Oops, that was loud at {location}. Sorry, everyone!

move.out.text: Off goes {survivor} to {location}. Be safe out there!

zombie.killed.text: Got one at {location}! One less to worry about!

barricade.built.text: Entrance {entrance} is boarded up. Cozy and safe!

exposure.wound.text: Ow, {survivor} took a hit. Tough as nails, though!

bite.chain.kill.text: Goodbye, {survivor}. I'm so sorry. It had to be done.

survivor.lost.other.text: I'm so sorry, {seat}. {survivor} was one of the good ones.

overrun.text: They broke in at entrance {entrance}! Okay, we can handle this!

food.short.text: Empty bellies... that costs us {n} morale. We'll find food!
Hungry, hungry. {n} morale lost. Chin up, everyone.

objective.progress.text: That's {n} so far! We're getting there!

crossroads.me.text: Big decision, my turn. Trust the gut!

accused.me.text: Me? Oh no, no, {seat}. I'd never. Let's sort it out.
{seat}, I'm just a guy with a thermos. Truly.
That hurts, {seat}, but I'll forgive you for it.

accused.other.text: Easy on {seat}, folks. I'm sure there's an explanation.

idle.text: Anyone want coffee? The thermos is still warm.

notes: Original persona. The first 24 lines (voiced) are the M4 set; the rest are text-only until someone prices their recordings.
